description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans grain-based reminder functionality, specifically using an in-memory reminder service backed by table storage. It sets up test fixtures, configures in-memory storage, and defines several test cases to verify reminder behaviors such as stopping, listing, multiple reminders, and handling not found scenarios.
